comment: Read from src/EugeneModule.cpp, src/OrbitsModule.cpp, src/EugeneWidget.cpp and manual/docs/index.md at commit 71660d9, the commit that raised the version to 2.0.4; the three later commits on the branch change a workflow file, the changelog and two SVG files. Parameter 8, RANDOM_KNOB_PARAM, is declared in src/EugeneModule.hpp but never given a widget in src/EugeneWidget.cpp, so it has no position, cannot be clicked, and gets no line; Polygene does place the equivalent button. The three CV jacks are stepped in effect rather than continuous: clampRounded at src/EugeneModule.cpp:5 adds a half and truncates, so the knob-plus-jack total lands on a whole number of beats or hits. The reverse and invert CV jacks use a Schmitt trigger with Rack's default thresholds, 0V and 1V, and while either is connected the matching panel switch is not read at all. The plugin-wide Theme menu item is cosmetic and carries no line, in line with the house rule. The display and its beat markers are drawn by a custom widget with no clickable parts.
